title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: Master Cassette Transfer->RR ->Cassette Transfer/editing//flac Conversion: Brian Mandel Cassette Transfer Nakamichi BX300-> Macintosh ->Peak Bias->JAM->cdr->EAC->flac

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording captures an excellent 1973 show with heartfelt energy and historic significance.
ai_review.review: All four reviewers rave about the performance, noting the warm, immersive audience tape that puts listeners right in the back row of the Coliseum. Despite limited detail on individual songs, the show is praised as a standout moment from ’73, especially given its timing just after Pig Pen’s passing, and the recording quality is considered surprisingly good for a covert taping.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.75) and uniformly positive language about both the show and the tape indicate an exceptional performance captured with excellent audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, clear AUD tape that captures ambience well; praised as impressive given the covert taping constraints of the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewers focus on overall excellence and emotional weight of the performance.
